title: review: B3 fix round: sync .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md line 1 with the reworded CLAUDE.md on task/T-0744 (gate red on test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists)
spec:
Why: B3 (T-0744, commit 474ec48 on branch task/T-0744) reworded CLAUDE.md line 1 as specified, but tests/test_goals.py::PlannerPromptAndConfig::test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists requires .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md line 1 to be identical to CLAUDE.md line 1, and planner.md was outside T-0744's scope, so the gate went red. This task continues on the same branch (constraints.fix_round_for = T-0744, so the worktree is cut from task/T-0744) with planner.md in scope.
What: set .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md line 1 to exactly CLAUDE.md line 1 as it stands on task/T-0744 ('# You are the Planner. A human approves every merge to main. Headless Planner launches pick their model through pool.toml [planner.routing] (Fable 5.1 escalation tier, Opus default candidate, shadow until evidence); the interactive session runs the model `orchestrator pick planner --model` names, Fable 5.1 today.'); change nothing else in planner.md (the rest of the file mirrors CLAUDE.md's Never/Always lists already and must keep matching them, so if the test also compares those lists, keep them identical). Re-run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh and commit. Everything from 474ec48 (cli pick --model, premium_summary interactive_by_goal/accepted_goals, format_premium_summary blocks, CLAUDE.md wording, the four B3 tests) stays.
acceptance: tests/test_goals.py::test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists — planner.md line 1 equals CLAUDE.md line 1 and the Never/Always lists still match

tests/test_cli.py::test_pick_planner_model_flag — `pick planner --model` prints the account line then a model line naming models.planner with a reason containing 'shadow' under the default config, and models.opus with 'active' when [planner.routing].mode is active; `pick planner` without the flag prints exactly the legacy single line
tests/test_planner_runs.py::test_premium_summary_includes_interactive_by_goal_and_accepted_goals — premium_summary returns both keys and None for a raising helper

tests/test_scorecard.py::test_format_premium_summary_renders_attribution_blocks — the 'interactive by goal (approximate):' block and the 'accepted goals:' line render when populated and are omitted when None
tests/test_cli.py::test_claude_md_planner_wording — CLAUDE.md's first line no longer says 'Planner (Fable 5.1)' and mentions [planner.routing] and `orchestrator pick planner --model`

result.summary: Verified against the actual files in wt/T-0744 (the diff's real location; this session's own worktree wt/T-0752 doesn't contain the change). planner.md line 1 now matches CLAUDE.md line 1 exactly (both reworded per B3), and the Never/Always sections still match between the two files (planner.md's Always section has the pre-existing headless-only addendum after a '\n\nHeadless' split, which the test explicitly accounts for and this task didn't need to touch). orchestrator/cli.py's `pick planner --model` correctly reads [planner.routing] via planner_router.load_cfg: default (shadow) mode prints models.planner with a reason containing 'shadow'; active mode prints models[default_tier] (opus) with a reason containing 'active'; without --model only the legacy single line prints. planner_runs.py's premium_summary wires interactive_by_goal and accepted_goals into the returned dict via try/except-wrapped calls into planner_telemetry (both functions exist with matching signatures), and scorecard.py's format_premium_summary renders the two new blocks only when populated. All five acceptance-named tests correspond to real, correctly-implemented behavior; no defects found.
